# Generated by cpp-anything bridge for textpkg (target: gcc 13, c++23).
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.28)
project(textpkg LANGUAGES CXX)

set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 23)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(CMAKE_CXX_EXTENSIONS OFF)
if(NOT CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE AND NOT CMAKE_CONFIGURATION_TYPES)
  set(CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE Release CACHE STRING "Build type" FORCE)
endif()

add_library(cppan_port_textpkg STATIC src/port.cpp)
# The shadow library links this statically: the port must be position independent.
set_target_properties(cppan_port_textpkg PROPERTIES POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON)
target_include_directories(cppan_port_textpkg PUBLIC ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/include)
target_compile_features(cppan_port_textpkg PUBLIC cxx_std_23)

if(MSVC)
  # /Zc:__cplusplus makes __cplusplus tell the truth; without it the
  # static_assert in profile.hpp cannot pass.
  target_compile_options(cppan_port_textpkg PRIVATE /W4 /permissive- /Zc:__cplusplus /utf-8)
else()
  target_compile_options(cppan_port_textpkg PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic -Wconversion -Wshadow)
endif()

add_executable(cppan_driver src/main.cpp src/dispatch.cpp)
target_link_libraries(cppan_driver PRIVATE cppan_port_textpkg)

# The shadow library: the same port, callable from the original's runtime so both
# can run on real traffic and be compared (`cpp-anything shadow .`).
add_library(cppan_shadow_textpkg SHARED src/shadow.cpp src/batch.cpp src/dispatch.cpp)
target_link_libraries(cppan_shadow_textpkg PRIVATE cppan_port_textpkg)
set_target_properties(cppan_shadow_textpkg PROPERTIES OUTPUT_NAME cppan_shadow)

if(CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_ID STREQUAL "GNU" AND CPPAN_MODULE_FLAGS)
  # Every translation unit that imports the module needs the flag, and the module
  # must exist before any of them is compiled.
  target_compile_options(cppan_driver PRIVATE ${CPPAN_MODULE_FLAGS})
  target_compile_options(cppan_shadow_textpkg PRIVATE ${CPPAN_MODULE_FLAGS})
  add_dependencies(cppan_driver cppan_module_textpkg)
  add_dependencies(cppan_shadow_textpkg cppan_module_textpkg)
endif()
